name: Way
summary: Shopify store locator on Google Maps with no API key needed, priced by location count rather than by feature: the paid tiers add locations and nothing else, and it also works with Apple Maps and Mapbox.
best_for: retailers and brands with physical stockists who want a Google Maps locator on their Shopify storefront without setting up a Maps API key or paying Google directly: the app handles the key on every tier, including the free one, which removes the developer step
skip_if: you have one shop and do not mind the app's branding under your map, because the free tier already covers you; or you need routing, appointment booking or stock-by-location, since this maps and directs and does not do any of that
honest_knock:
The pricing page reads like a feature ladder and behaves like a counter. Basic, Advanced and Pro list the same eight capabilities, so the $8 and $23 steps above Basic buy nothing but a higher location limit, and the jump from 50 to 500 leaves no tier in between. A chain with 60 or 80 shops pays the 500-location price and uses a tenth of it.

The free plan is usable on a live store, which is worth saying plainly: the same developer's Blocky and TiXel listings advertise free plans that turn out to be development stores only, and this one is not that. What it does carry is the app's branding on your storefront and a hard limit of one location, so it is a real free tier for a single shop rather than a trial in disguise.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic Plan · per month for up to 50 store locations, or $67.10 a year
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-04) Four tiers, and above the first one the ladder is a location counter rather than a feature list. Free carries one store location, the floating Google Maps locator, appearance customisation and online support, with the app's own branding shown on your storefront. Basic is $6.99 a month or $67.10 a year and removes that branding, raising the limit to 50 locations and adding the map widget as an app block, a pop-up modal for multiple locations, full customisation with custom CSS, and bulk import and export. Advanced at $14.99 a month or $143.90 a year and Pro at $29.99 or $287.90 list exactly the same eight features as Basic; what they add is headroom, 500 locations and 2,000. Annual billing saves a stated 20% on every paid tier and each carries a 7-day free trial. No Google Maps API key is required on any plan. Charges are in USD and recur every 30 days. One line in the feature bullets sits against all of that: it advertises unlimited store locations, which no plan card offers. Developer Effective Apps, Ashdod, Israel; the app launched 24 April 2020, carries Shopify's Built for Shopify badge, names eleven interface languages and works with Google Maps, Apple Maps, Mapbox and Shopify's B2B solution. The review record read 134 at 4.7 on 19 September 2026, up one from 16 September: 118 five-star, 11 four-star, none at three, 3 at two and 2 at one.

claims.observed: On the Free plan a location was added from the Google address suggestions and the floating pin opened Google Maps without any API key, Google account or card; the Free card in the app does not name No API key required, only the paid cards do.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The listing wording against one location and one floating pin in an unsaved theme preview; the paid map block was not tried, so the wording was not checked there.
claims.buying_consequence: You do not need a Google Maps key to get a pin on the free plan, although the free plan card does not say so.

claims.observed: After the App embed was switched on in the theme preview, a grey floating pin with the link Way Store Locator appeared in the lower right corner and a click opened Google Maps for the location. The theme change was not saved.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The Free card text against the pin in the editor preview; the pin was not seen on the live store because nothing was saved.
claims.buying_consequence: The free plan gives one floating pin that opens Google Maps; it is not a map on a page.

claims.claim: Embedding the map into your store pages is available on paid plans.
claims.observed: On the Free plan the app said this in a blue block and the tab Map in the preview was greyed out; the app block was not tried because it needs a paid plan.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The notice in the app against the greyed out Map tab on the Free plan; the paid app block was not opened.
claims.buying_consequence: A map on your own pages needs a paid plan, from $6.99 a month; the free plan only has the floating pin.

claims.observed: The plan cards say 1 location (Free) and Up to 50, 500 and 2000 locations for Basic, Advanced and Pro, as the listing does. One location was added on the Free plan; more locations and the 50 location limit were not tried.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The plan cards against the listing wording and one saved location; no second location, bulk import or limit was tried.
claims.buying_consequence: The location limits on the cards match the listing; the limit itself was not tested.

claims.claim: Basic Plan $6.99/month; Advanced Plan $14.99/month; Pro Plan $29.99/month
claims.observed: The monthly view of the plan page shows Free $0, Basic $6.99, Advanced $14.99 and Pro $29.99 a month, billed monthly, as the listing does.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The monthly prices on the cards against the listing; no approval screen was reached, so no total or tax was compared.
claims.buying_consequence: The monthly prices in the app equal the listing: $6.99, $14.99 and $29.99 a month.

claims.observed: The yearly view shows $5.59, $11.99 and $23.99 a month, billed annually, which equals $67.10, $143.90 and $287.90 a year as on the listing.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The yearly prices on the cards against the yearly totals of the listing; the yearly plan was not started.
claims.buying_consequence: Paying yearly saves about 20% against the monthly price, matching the listing.

claims.claim: Pick your plan to start a 7-days* free trial
claims.observed: The heading offers a 7 day free trial on the plan page, with a footnote that each store is entitled to a maximum of undefined trial days altogether; only the Free plan was chosen, so no trial was started or seen on an approval screen.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The heading and footnote of the plan page against a trial that was never started; no paid plan was clicked.
claims.buying_consequence: Whether a paid plan starts with 7 free days is not confirmed by a Shopify approval screen; the footnote on the page is unclear about the trial days.

claims.claim: BLACK FRIDAY SALE: Up To 50% OFF Claim Offer
claims.observed: A banner in the app offered up to 50% off with a Claim Offer link; it was not clicked, so the discounted prices were not seen. The plan cards showed the list prices.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The banner text against the plan cards; the offer page was not opened, so no discounted price was compared.
claims.buying_consequence: The offer is time limited and its prices were not seen; the prices on the cards are the list prices.

claims.observed: The paid plans were not clicked, so no Shopify approval screen, total, tax or renewal term was seen; the prices on the plan page could not be compared with a checkout.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the paid plans were not clicked
claims.comparability: The prices on the plan cards against a Shopify approval screen that never appeared; no tax, term or stored cost rule was compared.
claims.buying_consequence: The price you would pay for a paid plan is not confirmed by a Shopify approval screen; start with the Free plan and check the screen before you approve a paid plan.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Way (Google Maps store locator) on a Shopify development store: the install, the Free plan without a card or billing screen, one location with a public address added about 1 minute after the install form, the floating pin in an unsaved theme preview (App embed on) that opens Google Maps with no API key or Google account, the notice that embedding the map into store pages needs a paid plan, the plan page with the monthly and yearly prices (Free $0, Basic $6.99, Advanced $14.99, Pro $29.99 a month, equal to the listing), a Black Friday banner and the uninstall, which asks for a reason. Nothing was paid, approved or saved. Install: the app (App Store name Way: Google Maps Store Locator, listing apps.shopify.com/sticky-navigate-to-store; in the admin Way Store Locator) was installed from its App Store listing through the install form in our own tab. The install form was sent at 22:42:54; the dialog Install app showed Way Store Locator, with the permissions View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Online Store, Shopify admin). The app opened as a store locator. The listing matches the dossier: Free $0, Basic $6.99, Advanced $14.99 and Pro $29.99, 1, 50, 500 and 2000 locations, and the text no API key required. Plan choice: the page said Pick your plan to start a 7-days* free trial, with the footnote that each store is entitled to a maximum of undefined trial days altogether. The Free plan ($0, 1 location, Floating store locator, Online support, In-Store App Branding) was chosen. No card and no billing screen came up. The dashboard then said Welcome to Way Store Locator and Free Plan. Core action: Add store location was clicked; the title Test Stockist One and a public address (Museumstraat 1, Amsterdam, picked from the Google address suggestions) were entered and saved (Settings saved successfully). The first location stood on screen at 22:43:52, about 1 minute after the install form and in 4 steps after the plan choice. No Google Maps API key, Google account or card was needed. On the free plan the app said: Embedding the map into your store pages is available on paid plans. Upgrade to activate the app block; the tab Map in the preview was greyed out. A bar said ACTION REQUIRED: Turn on Way Store Locator's App Embed. In the theme editor preview (not saved) App embeds, Way Store Locator was switched on and a floating pin with the link Way Store Locator appeared in the lower right corner; a click on the pin opened Google Maps for the location in a new tab, which was closed. The theme change was not saved and was undone. Plans: monthly view Free $0/month, Basic Plan $6.99/month, Advanced Plan $14.99/month and Pro Plan $29.99/month (billed monthly); yearly view Basic $5.59/month, Advanced $11.99/month and Pro $23.99/month (billed annually), which equals the listing ($67.10, $143.90 and $287.90 a year). The cards say Up to 50, 500 and 2000 locations and Widget & App Block. Difference with the listing: the Free card in the app does not say No API key required (the paid cards do); in practice no API key was needed on the Free plan either. A banner said BLACK FRIDAY SALE: Up To 50% OFF with Claim Offer; it was not clicked. Checkout: only the Free plan was chosen and the paid plans were not clicked, so no Shopify approval screen, total, test charge or card field was seen. Nothing was approved. Cancelling: no paid plan was started. In Settings, Apps, Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall Way Store Locator?, which says that the app can no longer be used and that data managed by the app will be deleted; a reason is required (Testing multiple apps was chosen). The app was uninstalled after the evidence was complete and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the paid plans, bulk import by CSV, the app block or widget on a page (paid plans only), more than one location, the effect of the 50 location limit, stock per store and the Claim Offer banner. Clean up: the theme was not saved, the Google Maps tab and our own tab were closed, and the app was uninstalled. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: On the Free plan the map can only be shown as a floating pin that opens Google Maps; embedding the map into store pages needs a paid plan. The app embed has to be switched on in the theme first (the app shows an action required bar). The Free card does not say No API key required, which the listing does, although no key was needed in practice. The heading offers a 7 day trial while a footnote speaks of undefined trial days.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Way (Google Maps store locator) on a Shopify development store: the install, the Free plan without a card or billing screen, one location with a public address added about 1 minute after the install form, the floating pin in an unsaved theme preview (App embed on) that opens Google Maps with no API key or Google account, the notice that embedding the map into store pages needs a paid plan, the plan page with the monthly and yearly prices (Free $0, Basic $6.99, Advanced $14.99, Pro $29.99 a month, equal to the listing), a Black Friday banner and the uninstall, which asks for a reason. Nothing was paid, approved or saved. Install: the app (App Store name Way: Google Maps Store Locator, listing apps.shopify.com/sticky-navigate-to-store; in the admin Way Store Locator) was installed from its App Store listing through the install form in our own tab. The install form was sent at 22:42:54; the dialog Install app showed Way Store Locator, with the permissions View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Online Store, Shopify admin). The app opened as a store locator. The listing matches the dossier: Free $0, Basic $6.99, Advanced $14.99 and Pro $29.99, 1, 50, 500 and 2000 locations, and the text no API key required. Plan choice: the page said Pick your plan to start a 7-days* free trial, with the footnote that each store is entitled to a maximum of undefined trial days altogether. The Free plan ($0, 1 location, Floating store locator, Online support, In-Store App Branding) was chosen. No card and no billing screen came up. The dashboard then said Welcome to Way Store Locator and Free Plan. Core action: Add store location was clicked; the title Test Stockist One and a public address (Museumstraat 1, Amsterdam, picked from the Google address suggestions) were entered and saved (Settings saved successfully). The first location stood on screen at 22:43:52, about 1 minute after the install form and in 4 steps after the plan choice. No Google Maps API key, Google account or card was needed. On the free plan the app said: Embedding the map into your store pages is available on paid plans. Upgrade to activate the app block; the tab Map in the preview was greyed out. A bar said ACTION REQUIRED: Turn on Way Store Locator's App Embed. In the theme editor preview (not saved) App embeds, Way Store Locator was switched on and a floating pin with the link Way Store Locator appeared in the lower right corner; a click on the pin opened Google Maps for the location in a new tab, which was closed. The theme change was not saved and was undone. Plans: monthly view Free $0/month, Basic Plan $6.99/month, Advanced Plan $14.99/month and Pro Plan $29.99/month (billed monthly); yearly view Basic $5.59/month, Advanced $11.99/month and Pro $23.99/month (billed annually), which equals the listing ($67.10, $143.90 and $287.90 a year). The cards say Up to 50, 500 and 2000 locations and Widget & App Block. Difference with the listing: the Free card in the app does not say No API key required (the paid cards do); in practice no API key was needed on the Free plan either. A banner said BLACK FRIDAY SALE: Up To 50% OFF with Claim Offer; it was not clicked. Checkout: only the Free plan was chosen and the paid plans were not clicked, so no Shopify approval screen, total, test charge or card field was seen. Nothing was approved. Cancelling: no paid plan was started. In Settings, Apps, Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall Way Store Locator?, which says that the app can no longer be used and that data managed by the app will be deleted; a reason is required (Testing multiple apps was chosen). The app was uninstalled after the evidence was complete and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the paid plans, bulk import by CSV, the app block or widget on a page (paid plans only), more than one location, the effect of the 50 location limit, stock per store and the Claim Offer banner. Clean up: the theme was not saved, the Google Maps tab and our own tab were closed, and the app was uninstalled. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: On the Free plan the map can only be shown as a floating pin that opens Google Maps; embedding the map into store pages needs a paid plan. The app embed has to be switched on in the theme first (the app shows an action required bar). The Free card does not say No API key required, which the listing does, although no key was needed in practice. The heading offers a 7 day trial while a footnote speaks of undefined trial days.
